text:
elaine: Quick forum — we need a compact migration playbook for customers moving from prompt-based completions -> messages-based chat. Goal: minimize breakage, keep streaming parity, and give legal an immutable-system option.
ryan: High-level: canonical = messages[]. Accept prompt as a one-off shim for compatibility. Show deprecation header+metric. SDKs should surface both shapes.
chris: Engineering caveats: 1) prompt->messages translation must happen before token estimation. 2) streaming must not buffer: stream tokens as model emits. 3) name field on assistant messages is low-cost.
anika: From support: top customer concerns are (a) prompt suddenly changing system behavior, (b) differences in token billing, (c) webhooks/tools integration breaking. Need explicit migration docs and a replay harness.
maria: Compliance note: offer org-level flag `system_immutable=true` that prevents user/system collisions. Also require an audit log entry when server inserts system messages via migration tools.
ryan: Migration steps proposal: 1) provide `fromPrompt()` helper in SDKs that converts prompt -> messages with warning; 2) emit header X-Redwood-Compat: prompt-shim;deprecation=2026-06-01; 3) metric compat.prompt.used and compat.prompt.failed; 4) deprecation policy: 12mo.
chris: Rollout plan: feature flagged by org. Pilot with internal org + 5 customers. Canary 5% w/ shadowing 48h, then 25% 72h, then 100%. Circuit-breaker auto-rollback triggers on: error_rate>1% over 5m OR schema_hard_fail>0.2% over 1h OR token_delta_p95>12%.
anika: Support playbook: include quick rollback commands, how to enable `system_immutable` on behalf of customers, and a checklist to compare legacy vs shimmed outputs for N=100 sessions.
maria: Structured outputs: server accepts optional `schema` param. Response includes `structured_output_status` = ok|soft_fail|hard_fail and `schema_errors` array. On hard_fail, trigger alert and annotate request with `schema_hard_fail=true`.
chris: Function/tool calling: keep `function_call` opt-in. Map legacy `function_call` semantics to new `tools` field in docs, but accept both in the API for now. Translation metric: compat.func_call.mapped.
ryan: Metrics dashboard (PM visible): p50/p95 latency, regen_rate, compat.prompt.usage, compat.prompt.failure_rate, schema_ok/soft/hard rates, token_delta p50/p95, cost_delta_pct, streaming_latency_regressions.
anika: QA: create a capture & replay harness that replays 10k historical prompt requests through shim and compares tokens, outputs, and streaming behavior. Flag diffs > 1% for manual review.
chris: Circuit-breaker behavior: trip -> route traffic to legacy completions handler; also set org flag `use_legacy_chat_handler=true` for quick manual rollback. Implement a cooldown window and automated recovery attempts with health checks.
maria: Customer comms: announce migration timeline, how to opt-in early, how to enable `system_immutable`, and examples showing streaming parity. Provide an appendix: why roles matter (system/user/assistant) and examples of race conditions when mixing system content in prompt.
dev-rel-bot: Migration guide skeleton posted to #docs in 90m with code snippets for JS/Python/Go and a sample replay harness script.
ryan: Minimal launch surface (MVP): canonical `messages` support, prompt shim with deprecation header & metric, streaming parity for shim, SDK helpers, org feature flags, circuit-breaker + auto-rollback, basic schema validation (beta flag). Advanced: full schema enforcement and tools mapping after MVP.
elaine: Action owners: Chris -> shim + streaming parity (due EOW), Ryan -> SDK helpers + dashboard (due next Wed), Maria -> schema contract + compliance notes (due EOW), Anika -> support & QA harness (due next Fri), DevRel -> docs + examples (in 48h). I'll post the playbook doc after lunch. Any objections?
ryan: One more: add alerts: `schema_hard_fail > 0.1%/1h` and `token_delta_p95 > 10%` to auto-roll triggers.
elaine: OK locking this plan unless objections by EOD. We'll include the exact header name and deprecation date in the docs. :rocket:
